verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at docs.fireflies.ai (HTTP 200) indexing the docs as Markdown pages (e.g. introduction.md, quickstart.md). Fireflies also documents a dedicated Documentation MCP Server so AI tools can search and retrieve its docs directly, and GraphQL introspection lets an agent discover the API schema. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or how complete the llms.txt index is, and no independent or hands-on reports of agents actually using the docs MCP server.
